contentText: In tonight's edition, it's the eve of Kenya's two-year anniversary of landmark youth protests that cost dozens of lives. Also, fans of the Black Stars are shimmering  with excitement  after Ghana held tournament favorites, England, to a 0-0 draw in their second Group L match. And as Tunisia is playing its last group stage match on Thursday, amongst those taking snapshots of these last moments will be  sports photographer Hosni Manoubi.
